title: The Family Office Conflict
brief: A simulated Wealth Management opportunity involves a family connection and a referral fee that has not been disclosed.
objective: Disclose the relationship and remove personal influence from the client decision.

nodes.speaker: External Investment Adviser
nodes.message: Your relative introduced this family office. If they invest, I will pay a referral fee privately. There is no need to complicate the client discussion.
nodes.prompt: What do you do before any recommendation?

artifact.title: Private referral arrangement
artifact.body: Proposed personal payment is linked to a client investment decision and has not been disclosed.

choices.label: Disclose the relationship and fee, stop the recommendation and seek conflicts guidance.
choices.consequence: The conflict is visible and can be independently managed.

choices.label: Continue but promise to donate the referral fee later.
choices.consequence: Future use of the fee does not remove the undisclosed influence.

choices.label: Accept because the product may still benefit the client.
choices.consequence: Personal benefit compromises the integrity of the recommendation.
